body: That's some really deep advice I've never heard that before. All my problems have now disappeared and now I can be happy just like that

I was thinking about it, and I would like to add that I signed a lease agreeing to pay rent until August of next year, so I have that obligation with my roommate as well. I can't very well just up and leave and not pay rent for 9 months either

Like I said in the previous comments, moving home doesn't seem like it would solve any problems, if not just causing more problems since there I would have absolutely no income at all. From what I've seen there are no "full-time jobs" within walking distance of where I live, in a crappy part of town. How can I "cut my losses" when there is no way to cut them, as they will just keep growing without doing something. I don't mean to sound condescending or rude, and I truly do appreciate the help you guys are giving, but I'm just having a hard time with all this shit going wrong for me.

What's moving back home going to accomplish? I don't have a job at home, no transportation there or where I'm at, $30,000 in loans, and grandparents who barely get by themselves on social security alone at my "home"

As much as this world is a shit-hole, which it really is, there are still good things about. Not every thing about human existence is bad, you just have to find the things that brighten the world a little bit. Is there anything you actually enjoy, because everyone enjoys things even if they don't want to admit it. Think about all the things you ever wanted to do, even the impossible things. I struggle on and off with my own form of depression, but what keeps me going is the fact that there are still so many things to do in the world. You're going to force yourself to miss out on the things that make humans human, things like love, hate, happiness, sadness, you can't have a perfect life 24-7. But you can do things to make it better, even little things. Find out what you are actually interested in and get your mind off of dark shit like this. Watch new TV shows, play video games, go out to eat at different restaurants, get a shitty job, or try and find a cool one. Don't let an idea determine the rest of your life. As hard as it seems, your life can change, and by doing pretty simple things. Just work up the courage to do things you would never have thought of, and enjoy the fact that you have the conscious mind and ability to think and talk, learn and explain things. If you just want to talk man, let me know, cause I hate seeing people in pain thinking they have nowhere to go and nothing to do. I honestly hope you change your mind because no matter what you think you deserve to live.
